findings.location: div.card.kpi (two tiles) dist/assets/index-DKXolRs7.js:1, at 1280 and 375, light and dark

The first tile read is the store penetration "38.6%" (the left tile and first in order), while the brief names the advisor's dominant element as "マイ目標まで あと N件" and says the store penetration moves into the comparison line and the tile row is "none". findings.location: div.grid with div.card.kpi and section.card, dist/assets/index-DKXolRs7.js:1, at 1280
findings.evidence: generic shape: a 2 x 2 grid of four bordered cards of equal width (rects x292 w468 and x780 w468 in both rows; row 1 y105 h139, row 2 y264 h229 and h307). The brief calls for sections on the ground with hairline-divided rows, no panel borders, and a two-to-one supporting pane from 1024px; the capture shows equal columns and every region boxed (class "card"), so the 要対応 list and the notices carry the same weight as the figures and swapping the two columns would not change the reading. Group separation uses gap 20 between cards and 20 inside the grid, the same value between all four boxes, so no cue ranks the groups.
findings.fix: Drop the card borders on the two list sections, set the lists on the ground with a heading each, and use the 3fr/2fr columns from 1024px with the 要対応 list as the wide column; keep a larger gap between the figure and the lists than between the two lists.

findings.location: a rows in 要対応 and 未読のお知らせ (a[href^='#/inquiries?', a[href^='#/notices/']) dist/assets/index-DKXolRs7.js:1, at 1280 and 375
findings.evidence: state expression: the three 要対応 rows (w466 h56) and the three notice rows (w466 h82) are links in the dump's controls but show no trailing arrow or chevron, while the two KPI tiles carry an arrow icon at their top right and the section header carries an underlined blue link ("未読のお知らせを開く", colour oklch(0.546 0.215 263)). Three different cues mark "this opens something" on one screen, and the rows (the second element in the reading order) have none. The screenshot shows no hover or focus state at rest, so the capture alone does not tell whether a row hover exists.
findings.fix: Give list rows one trailing chevron (as the tiles use an arrow) or one shared hover background; use the same affordance for every row that opens a list or a single view.

findings.evidence: inconsistent spacing between siblings: both tiles are h139 at 375, but the first tile's label wraps to two lines (label to value gap about 20px at the 2nd line) while the second tile's one-line label "マイ目標到達までの残件" sits above a value at the same offset from the card top, leaving about 40px between label and value; at 1280 the gap is 24px (label bottom y142, value top y166). findings.fix: Let each tile size to its content (drop the shared fixed height) or put the value on a shared baseline row in both tiles, and give both tiles the same set of icons.

Cold-read answers: (1) first landing is the store penetration "38.6%" at every width and theme, which does not match the brief's dominant element for an advisor (P2-1); (2) three emphasis levels survive; (3) first four stops are 38.6% -> 2件 -> 対応が必要な項目 -> 未読のお知らせ, which follows the brief's reading order except that the figure and comparison line are replaced by two equal tiles; (4) two equal-sized siblings in the top region, equality is not earned because the brief wants one dominant figure; (5) separation by boxes with a uniform 20px gap, the gap between groups is not larger than the gap within the grid; (6) yes, a run of equal tiles followed by equal panels, reordering would not change the meaning (P2-2); (7) labels such as "回答ありの問い合わせ", "満期3か月以内で意向未確認の契約" and the campaign names tie it to this product, but the 2 x 2 card grid layout is shared with any dashboard; (8) density fits the monitor job: content ends at y611 of 1200 at 1280, three rows per list.
